purpose: Append-only repair of CF4 distance typing, immutable code-pin enforcement and nonfinite geometry rejection.

counterevidence: DMzp and Dist were not paired by an executable catalog-rounding check
module-semantic and test pins were recorded but not enforced before build
some public geometry entry points did not fail closed on nonfinite values

canonical_mask.interpretation: Canonical uint8 mask produced by inspection of the exact pinned pickle opcode stream. No pickle opcode is executed; STACK_GLOBAL, REDUCE and BUILD are inert data seen only by pickletools.genops.

DMzp.role: rounding consistency and uncertainty coordinate only

Dist.role: sole Mpc input to geometry and FLRW inversion

cf4_distance_columns.identity: Dist=10^((DMzp-25)/5) Mpc before independent catalog rounding
cf4_distance_columns.tolerance: abs(Dist-D_formula)<=0.05 Mpc + D_formula*(10^(0.0005/5)-1), covering half of the 0.1 Mpc Dist step and half of the 0.001 mag DMzp step
